subject: [PATCH 34/60] mm/mempolicy: don't rebind policies onto private nodes

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: No substantive comments or reviews have been provided so far. The patch author has not addressed any concerns or questions raised by the community.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series addresses issues related to memory policy rebinding onto private nodes in the Linux kernel. The current implementation allows policies to be rebound over private nodes, which can lead to unexpected behavior and bugs. This patch introduces a new function `mpol_rebindable_mems` that rebinds policies over non-private nodes, ensuring that adding or removing private nodes does not affect policy rebinding.
